shop/in-place

What it is
  = It takes a new text where it is, and does nothing for it.
  After a restart:
    title: Taken up where it was
  Runs:
    title: On, for what it hears

What it hears, and what it then does
  `thing.changed`: a thing was changed [on.changed/@]
    from: Heard from its own project, and from the factory itself.
    Do nothing. [on.changed/run]

What it may do
  = It runs as whoever applies it, and can do no more than they can.

What it does as it ends or is changed
  = When it takes a new text while it is running, it goes on where it is: its steps are not run again.
    ending: update
